notes.content: [p]Hi,  [/p][p][/p][p]Today we're introducing the [b]Hint Update[/b] which enhances Pup Champs with some cool features that we hope will make the game more accessible for everyone :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/ec7454b877bbdc98665bff18ab0cedeff95ef95e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The big one is the introduction of something we mentioned during the last update - a [b]hint system[/b] which we hope will give you a tiny nudge when you need one. Aside from that we've got a new mouse cursor, info about our other games, petting pups & more![/p][p][/p][p]Patch notes for [b]version 1.20[/b]: [/p][list][*][p][b]Added the Hint System,[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]The Hint System displays the intended solution for each puzzle, step-by-step,[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Accessible through a new button in the top-right corner of the replay all hints unveiled up to this point,[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]If you don't want to engage with this feature you can disable it in [/i]Settings > Accessibility > Hint System,[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/294ecaf2a2ef6c502a7c46875d0fe9f74dad0927.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Added a new mouse cursor,[/p][list][*][p][i]For those notes.title: Pup Champs v1.10 (29 May 25) - Epilogue Update
notes.content:
Hi,

Hope you've had time to get through Pup Champs' story because the game just got bigger!

With the [b]Epilogue Update[/b] we're introducing [b]Chapter 8[/b], featuring [b]19 new puzzles[/b] to solve along with a final comic strip to bring the narrative full circle. With this update we're bringing the initial 150+ puzzle count all the way to [b]170+ hand-crafted brain-teasers[/b] for you to solve. Aside from that we've got UI improvements, bugfixes and more to make the game even more enjoyable.

We've also read your feedback regarding the game's difficulty and wanted to mention that we're currently working hard on a [b]hint mode[/b] for the game that should assist you with some of the more challenging puzzles. This feature will ship in an update that we are currently planning to ship next month. 

Now, on to the patch notes for [b]version 1.10[/b]:
[list]
[*] Added Chapter 8 with 19 new puzzles and a new story comic,
[*] >>> [i]Featuring some of our trickiest puzzles yet and an epilogue to the game's narrative - we hope you have enjoyed the pups' journey :)[/i]
[*] >>> [i]There are also two new achievements to earn, if that's your thing![/i]

[*] Added decorations to the level select menu,
[*] >>> [i]We felt that the main menu was a bit too plain so we added some doodles in each chapter to make the level select menu feel a bit more alive,[/i]

[*] Updated levels 6-N and 7-11 with alternative solutions,
[*] Improved camera settings on all levels of the game,
[*] Improved texture compression for story comics,
[*] Changed palette in the [spoiler]hidden level[/spoiler],
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes navigation would get stuck on unit portraits, forcing you to change units instead of kicking the ball when playing on the keyboard,
[*] Updated SFX when Bull collides with another unit,
[/list]

Pup Champs was also featured during today's [url=https://thinkygames.com/direct/]Thinky Direct[/url] and will be taking part in the [url=https://www.cerebralpuzzleshowcase.com]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url] from [b]May 29th till June 5th[/b]! (though the launch discount is only valid until June 2nd - so be sure to buy the game before it runs out!) 

Below is our new trailer if you want to check it out:

[previewyoutube=malMZ4caTuU;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope you enjoy this new update :)

[i]PS. We've also just launched a major update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967510/Railbound/]Railbound[/url], so check it out if you're interested in creating your own puzzles for the game![/i]

notes.title: Next Fest Demo - Perspective Update
notes.content:
We're back with a [b]brand-new demo,[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2848800/Pup_Champs/]available now on Steam[/url], just in time for Next Fest which starts on Monday.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978840/Pup_Champs_Demo/

[previewyoutube=gP3_pNslPxY;full][/previewyoutube]
Since November we've been working hard on another major art overhaul for the game. One thing we noticed when Pup Champs was shown at various events and showcases was that the game looked good in motion but lacked energy when displayed via static screenshots.

This is why we decided to [b]bring the game from pure 2D into 3D[/b], skewing the perspective a bit to make the scene appear more dynamic, and give ourselves some camera tools for bringing more life to the backgrounds. The way you play the game remains the same (just better), but now everything should look cooler.

Aside from that we've got improved UI, new puzzles, two new story comics, a major animation rework and much, much more!

[h2]Patch notes for Pup Champs v0.5:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Pup Champs is now Steam Deck Verified![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/079d550b52edc06f37e5053d443106cd8af933f3.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Reworked game camera from orthogonal into perspective,[/b]
[*]      [i]> This is a big art-related update that we started working on even before v0.4 was out - the game’s art felt flat on static screenshots, and we hope that this perspective change will make the gameplay feel more dynamic,[/i]
[*] [b]Implemented new camera features,[/b]
[*]      [i]> Now you can move the camera around (middle-mouse / right stick on controller) and zoom in/out (mouse scroll / LT & RT),[/i]
[*]      [i]> Play around with them to see the updated level visuals too![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/c2a5265b199327eb2794f6c1b12d7e9ea73f5123.png[/img]
[*] [b]Updated puzzles available in the demo,[/b]
[*]      [i]> Added all-new levels in Chapter 3,[/i]
[*]      [i]> Added bonus levels in Chapter 3,[/i]
[*]      [i]> Updated existing levels in Chapters 1 & 2,[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/5dc194b39d5b71bb6df1a56f8402baf31e2caf80.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Added new mechanic - moles,[/b]
[*]      [i]> Moles occupy two spaces on the field, blocking one tile (head) and switching between them if the other tile (exit) is triggered,[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/9c48c2b6f5d7f8dc810c18a96cd4e188124e6179.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Added new mechanic - mud,[/b]
[*]      [i]> Whenever the ball lands in the mud, it can’t be removed from this tile without kicking it, creating a space that you need to be careful around![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/f221ab3f70bb0c999098102d0b9c5cfa8cadb4c5.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Pug is back with a new kick type![/b]
[*]      [i]> This unit is able to kick the ball backwards by one tile, opening up a bunch of new design possibilities that weren’t there before,[/i]
[*]      [i]> This one is a work-in-progress animation-wise, but we really wanted to put it in your hands and see how it feels - let us know your feedback![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/896f9a2ba85f9110c6b6a4fa02e8d20b9ef65296.png[/img]
[*] [b]Added two new story comics in Chapter 2,[/b]
[*]      [i]> Introducing a new teammate and an important in-game mechanic,[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/c7144f0b158d451a48c0b3730a911f28ca0f8a21.png[/img]
[*] [b]Updated in-game UI,[/b]
[*]      [i]> We moved unit cards from left side to bottom of the screen to center the game’s layout and give ourselves more space for displaying horizontal grids, which make up the majority of puzzles in the game.[/i]
[*]      [i]> Also - we cleaned up fonts, input glyphs, sprites and other things while we were at it![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/35501c1ddb671301c9157719e807e01e0f2d5bc9.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Improved nearly all animations in the game,[/b]
[*]      [i]> Improved synchronization for animation playback,[/i]
[*]      [i]> Reworked animations when units pick up and move the ball around,[/i]
[*]      [i]> Reworked animations when units kick the ball,[/i]
[*]      [i]> Reworked animations when the ball hits the net,[/i]
[*]      [i]> Added new player unit reaction animations when scoring a goal,[/i]

[*] Added new sound effects and tweaked existing ones,
[*] Added extra ground detail decorations and fixed vertical grass stripe appearance,
[*] Reworked decorations on the sides of each level,
[*]      [i]> This is something that was enabled by our new camera settings - an additional multiplane with trees to make the visuals a bit richer,[/i]
[*] Fixed issues related to sprite layering and masking,
[*]      [i]> Sometimes certain things would show up in front of others when they shouldn’t; this issue should be improved now, but expect more improvements in the future,[/i]
[*] Reworked VFX when a player unit is able to finish the level,
[*]      [i]> The old VFX felt like a bit too much when paired with all the other art-related changes we made, so we toned it down,[/i]
[*] Refactored gameplay code to make it more stable and cleaner,
[*] Reworked demo end screen to make it look nicer,
[*] Reworked gamepad controls,
[*] Improved VFX when Monkeys bump into other units,
[*] Improved tutorials in Chapters 1 & 2,
[*] Updated visual palette in Chapter 3,
[*] Reworked visuals for Bushes and added a new VFX when entering them,
[*] Improved player selection / stamina marker,
[*] Improved visuals for ball trajectory shown before kicking,
[*] Improved fonts in main menu,
[*] Improved display for in-game shadows,
[*] Fixed issue where ball would sometimes reposition itself slightly when restarting a level,
[/list]

Thanks for reading, and we hope you'll enjoy the updated demo :)

Cheers,
- Luke

notes.title: Demo v0.4 available now - reworked input, directional sprites & more
notes.content:
After launching v0.3 back in mid-August we spent some time showing the Pup Champs demo to players around Europe - specifically at Gamescom and Poznan Game Arena - to see how they resonate with the game.

As a result we decided to make some core changes to how the game works in order to make it easier to play and more fun. Two big changes in this release are the [b]reworked input[/b], which should allow you to solve puzzles quicker and make the game feel snappier; and [b]new sprites for all units[/b] to better show their current orientation. The latter one was an especially big pain point for demo players, and we hope this change helps improve that.

If you’ve played the demo in the past you might not feel like a lot has changed since there’s barely any new „content” (as in, puzzles) in this update, but hopefully our big under-the-hood changes will make Pup Champs better than ever :)

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/e902120d523f09565d9f11936d975b4eb8bef246.png[/img]
[*] [b]Reworked player navigation to support instant movement,[/b]
[*]     [i]> This is an experimental feature - we’re super eager to hear your thoughts about this feature, and we have further tweaks planned in the future,[/i]
[*]     [i]> Previously, you needed to draw the movement line and release in order to perform navigation - now units start moving the moment you start drawing in order to make solving puzzles faster,[/i]
[*]     [i]> We hope this should be especially helpful for players using keyboards/gamepads :)[/i]

[*] [b]Reworked unit path visuals,[/b]
[*]     [i]> We’ve done some tweaks to how the dashed line is displayed on the grid, but we’re not finished with it yet :)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/5c338ea4a4cb77cac8a67007132d4db69af885e6.png[/img]
[*] [b]Reworked unit sprites to better show which direction they are facing,[/b]
[*]     [i]> Previously we only had a single set of sprites facing left or right, and we relied on an arrow marker to show where the unit is currently looking,[/i]
[*]     [i]> Now, each unit can rotate in each of the 4 directions (up/down/left/right) which we hope will help players confused by not being able to change their shooting vector while standing in place,[/i]

[*] [b]Reworked line visuals showing ball trajectory while aiming,[/b]
[*]     [i]> After showing Pup Champs at events we noticed that some players were confused by the arrow and assumed that in order to launch the ball they need to perform the motion shown by it (swiping along the arrow); instead of just tapping on the target,[/i]
[*]     [i]> We’ve got some more visual tweaks coming for this feature in the upcoming releases,[/i]

[*] [b]Reworked puzzles in Chapters 1, 2 and 3,[/b]
[*]     [i]> We noticed certain players getting stuck at various points during the campaign, so we shuffled the puzzles around and removed some of them for the time being in order to create a smoother experience,[/i]
[*]     [i]> While some of the hardest puzzles might no longer be playable, we hope you’ll enjoy the new ones we’ve added :)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/21ca1739d4a7167ee2f5a076d576b21b4d870ac6.png[/img]
[*] [b]Reworked the kicking mechanic for Golden Retriever,[/b]
[*]     [i]> Previously the kick had a range limit (4) but you could decide where to stop the ball; now the kick is essentially limitless, but someone needs to intercept it or it needs to land inside of the goal,[/i]
[*]     [i]> This change was prompted by seeing lot of players solving level c2-3 in a specific way - by passing to the other unit instead of stopping it in front of the goal for a pass; after thinking about it we decided that the new mechanic should be more intuitive for everyone,[/i]

[*] [b]Reworked the design for Monkey,[/b]
[*]     [i]> This ties into the instant-movement feature mentioned above - since player units now move immediately as the command is given to them, Monkeys needed to start moving in unison with them,[/i]
[*]     [i]> This change resulted in some of the pre-existing puzzles not being solvable anymore, so we tweaked some late Chapter 3 puzzles,[/i]
[*]     [i]> The design of this unit is not completed yet - expect further tweaks to the UX and rules in the future,[/i]

[*] [b]Simplified keyboard/gamepad interaction when kicking the ball,[/b]
[*]     [i]> Previously, players needed to press the interact button once to enter the „kicking mode” and press the button again to confirm; now this first interaction is not needed and you only need to press once in order to kick the ball,[/i]
[*]    [i] > „Kicking mode” was necessary for handling Golden Retriever’s kicking, to allow you to select where to stop the ball; once we changed the kicking mechanic this mode also became unnecessary,[/i]

[*] Pug was benched from Chapters 2 and 3 for the time being…
[*]     [i]> In earlier versions of the game we felt the need to rush through introducing the full team of 4 units in order to construct bigger puzzles starting from the end of Chapter 2; after reevaluation we decided to spread them out a little bit more in order to focus on some non-unit-based mechanics,[/i]
[*]     [i]> The Pug will return after he’s done with training camp and has learned a new skill :)[/i]

[*] Units are automatically selected at the start of each level and cannot be un-selected,
[*]     [i]> This should make it easier to figure out who’s currently being controlled and make keyboard/gamepad navigation snappier,[/i]

[*] Reworked unit idle animations,
[*]     [i]> We felt that giving everyone sprite animations while standing idly was too distracting, so we opted for a simpler scale bounce animation,[/i]

[*] Improved tutorials in Chapter 1,
[*]     [i]> Added a new tutorial hand sprite to make it stand out more from the environment,[/i]
[*]     [i]> Added input icons next to tutorial hand when using keyboard/gamepad,[/i]
[*]     [i]> Added tutorials to levels d1-8 and d1-10,[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/231754940ca4f40ef2ae56b6807373b9df847197.png[/img]
[*] Added more character sprites to the Victory Screen,
[*]     [i]> This UI felt somewhat static, especially during the first batch of levels - 1-1 to 1-8 - where after every goal you had to look at the same Shiba pose over and over again,[/i]
[*]     [i]> Now each pup has 3 separate sprites which are cycled in order to make this screen feel better,[/i]

[*] Reworked undo to revert actions tile-by-tile instead of reverting the entire movement sequence,
[*] Updated color palette and sprites related to passing / receiving / kicking the ball,
[*] Updated sprites for bush tiles,
[*] Increased goal hitbox to make it easier to click,
[*] Added new ability icons for each unit,
[*] Added animation to unit stamina marker on the field when in use,
[*] Improved ball positioning when being held by a unit,
[*] Improved sprite reaction when Monkey is blocked from entering a tile,
[*] Replaced input icons for keyboard/gamepad prompts to make them fit the UI better,
[*] Fixed being able to scroll through comic pages too quickly when clicking on the left/right side before the button was visible,
[*] Tweaked gamepad stick deadzones to avoid unwanted moves in the other direction,
[*] Tweaked delay before showing the Victory Screen in order to show the ball actually landing in the goal,
[/list]

That’s it for today - please enjoy this updated demo and let us know your thoughts!

Cheers,

The team at Afterburn

notes.title: Try demo v0.3 now! - featuring story comics, new music & more!
notes.content:
Hi,

It's been a busy time at our studio - we've managed to ship a ton of improvements to our demo just in time for Gamescom! We've got new story artwork, puzzles, music and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978840/Pup_Champs_Demo/


[h2]Patch notes for Pup Champs v0.3:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Added first three story comics to Chapter 1,[/b]
[*] [i]>>> We've teased this in the July updated and it's finally here! These comics represent how we'd like to tell the story in Pup Champs' campaign and we hope you'll enjoy the pups' journey :)[/i]

[*] [b]Added language support for: Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese-Brazil, and Spanish,[/b]
[*] [i]>>> As always, don't expect a ton of text in an Afterburn game, but it should help you navigate the options menu![/i]

[*] [b]Added save game support keeping track of which levels were completed,[/b]
[*] [i]>>> This should help alleviate the "after returning to the main menu I don't know which level I was last playing" problem that plagued the previous versions of the demo.[/i]

[*] Added a new music track to chapters 1 and 3,
[*] Added shadow to the cone obstacle sprite,
[*] Added a "Pup Champs" version watermark in the bottom right corner,
[*] Added a wishlist button to the game,
[*] Added a "clear save" menu,

[*] [b]Updated puzzles in all three chapters of the demo,[/b]
[*] [i]>>> We've reworked, removed and added new levels to make the overall progression smoother and help new players figure out the ins and outs of our mechanics - we're super eager to hear how you're enjoying these new puzzles![/i]

[*] [b]Updated player stats across all puzzles,[/b]
[*] [i]>>> We've received feedback that changing unit kick strength between puzzles sometimes felt confusing to players, which is why we've decided to redesign it to make it consistent. Now you can always expect a certain pup to kick in a specific way - but their stamina will still vary from level to level to spice things up.[/i]

[*] Improved unit outlines and kick markers,
[*] Improved camera layout on all levels,
[*] Improved keyboard and gamepad input,
[*] Fixed issue with keyboard/gamepad navigation marker appearing in main menu when using mouse,
[/list]

That's all for today as we're preparing ourselves for Gamescom - if you're around you can find us between August 21st and 23rd in Hall 4.1, booth C013g!

Cheers,
Luke from Afterburn

notes.title: Demo v0.2 out now! - featuring updated input & art
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

In our last newsletter we talked about the work we've been doing over the past few months to improve Pup Champs' quality. However, it's one thing to read about the improvements we've been doing - and another to try it out for yourself. This is why we've prepared an updated demo that's [b]available now[/b] so that you can see how the game has progressed :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978840/Pup_Champs_Demo/

Since last week, Steam has enabled the option of reviewing demos, so if you've tried out the new Pup Champs demo be sure to send us feedback using a review, the Community Hub or our [url=https://discord.gg/afterburn]Discord[/url] - we're reading everything as we strive to make the game the best it can be.

[h2]Patch notes for Pup Champs v0.2 demo:[/h2]

[i](points marked with a star - * - are a work-in-progress and you should expect more improvements there in the future)[/i]

[list]
[*] [b]*added gamepad and keyboard support to the game[/b]
[*] added a transition animation when going between main menu and gameplay scenes,
[*] added VFX to pup and ball movement,
[*] improved animations for ball movement,
[*] [b]*updated backgrounds on all levels,[/b]
[*] *updated artwork for markers that show where the ball will land,
[*] updated game icon,
[*] updated artwork for dashed line that shows current movement path,
[*] updated shadow animations,
[*] reworked most levels to feature consistent kick strength between pups [i](we hope this allows you to have an easier time remembering which pup works best in different scenarios)[/i],

[*] added a new button to the main menu - "leave a review"
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/4956b3b17b1986ec949c3d97b992085f089c4e20.png[/img]

That's all for today - we hope you have fun with the new demo :)

Cheers,
Luke

notes.title: July 2024 dev update - new artwork & more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/67bc4239cb28a8ea10b7e920ab5c376786b6c3c8.png[/img]

[u][h2]Pup Champs - updated artwork & logo![/h2][/u]
The game's store page recently got a big update with a fantastic new main artwork created by the amazing [url=http://www.instagram.com/wolski.igor/]Igor Wolski[/url]; as well as a brand-new logo designed by our friends over at [url=makakistudio.com/]Makaki Studio[/url]. The same team was in charge of doing the key art / logotype for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967510/Railbound/]Railbound[/url] and we're thrilled to have them back.

We've also prepared a wallpaper version of the artwork below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/efd2e76469a296822e755fd6fab13e29f1cd606a.png[/img]

[u][h2]Pup Champs - July development update[/h2][/u]
Aside from that, the team's been hard at work on new content and improvements for the game.

One major feature we've wanted to add to the May demo (but unfortunately we ran out of time) was [b]keyboard and gamepad controls[/b]. We're big fans of the Steam Deck as a gaming platform and the way you currently interact with Pup Champs there is... lacking, to say the least.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/596d5ac45e08e661ffcd58a79da17835cbd8b7c3.jpg[/img]
In the new build we've got both keyboard and gamepad working across the whole game, though there are still improvements we want to make to these systems before the new demo. (you might spot the good ol' Railbound crosshair in the screenshot above - we often borrow assets from our old games when working on features for the new ones).

Something we're also tackling is [b]improved backgrounds[/b] for the puzzles. The demo used a system for randomizing prepared sprites; this allowed us to quickly create variant backgrounds (Railbound uses a somewhat-similar system!) but when used for 2D art it made the sprites look a bit out of place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/e1ba295e012c5ed10602692f25f4c83a6410690c.jpg[/img]
Since then we pivoted to more hand-drawn backgrounds (you can see a comparison above) to which we'll be adding some elements to make them feel more alive:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/0996d608bc168e3078f87adbb8cd7f10501798de.gif[/img]

If you've seen our Steam store descriptions you might've spotted mentions of a "retired football coach" and "the underdog's tale" - that's because we're also working on adding a [b]story[/b] to bind the game's campaign together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/96283f8a1623b8d446563c84844034b0c933b71c.jpg[/img]
In Pup Champs we're taking what we learned from creating a story for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567440/inbento/]inbento[/url] to craft a simple-yet-heartwarming tale of neighborhood pups coming together through the fun of playing soccer, told through textless comic strips. We'll have more info to share with you in the future, but for now I'll leave you with the above sketch as an appetizer.

We're currently planning to release an updated demo of Pup Champs with these new features (and more!) in [b]mid-August[/b], but if you'd like to play the current version or wishlist the game, you can do it on our Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2848800/Pup_Champs/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/28124a3637f57833bfc12c4cb658fb7ccddb1183.jpg[/img]
[u][h2]Showing off the pups[/h2][/u]
In terms of showcasing the game we've also had a busy time - Pup Champs was featured at the [url=https://x.com/AfterburnGames/status/1799486360618704909]Wholesome Direct[/url], popped up during the [url=https://x.com/sftrabbit/status/1795034970446061835]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url] and helped collect money for a good cause during the [url=https://x.com/AfterburnGames/status/1799532209763704875]Games For Waves - World Ocean Day[/url] sale event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/e863113088bf903fc267eac1ed0abc9dc2e5da8d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/ad3662fb4793b1b46326debeba951f68328d7957.jpg[/img]
We also visited our local gamedev student competition - [url=https://gry.it.p.lodz.pl/main/index.php/pl/]ZTGK (Zespołowe Tworzenie Gier Komputerowych)[/url] - to see some budding talent, give out awards for their great work and also to do a test run of our new booth for Pup Champs with tablets, stickers & mascots inspired by the game.

These small fellas were handmade by [url=https://www.instagram.com/liskowe_crochety/]Liskowe Crochety[/url] and we're super happy with how they turned out :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899808/18ec8e0ade8abb2eaf962971c994c6910e10b03c.jpg[/img]

That's all we have for now - thanks once more for reading the whole newsletter and we hope to see you again when the new demo is out! Until next time!

- Luke
